title: Visual Listening In: Extracting Brand Image Portrayed on Social Media
authors: Liu Liu; Daria Dzyabura; Natalie Mizik
eligible_reason: Deep-learning measurement paper: trains BrandImageNet on Flickr images, applies it to Instagram brand images, validates against human labels and a brand-perception survey (correlations), and compares consumer vs firm photos for underwear brands (t-tests). No binary staggered treatment and no DiD or event study.
design_notes: Python/Caffe pipeline (src/*.py, *.sh) and Jupyter notebooks for evaluation (Tables 1-4), correlation analysis (Tables 5-6) and the Hanes/Joeboxer/Victoria's Secret case study (Table 7, t-tests). Regression inventory empty.
data_files_note: Survey, label and prediction files shipped; raw images must be downloaded with the supplied scripts (Instagram public API since closed).
screener_notes: No article text or PDF available locally (data/text/mksc and papers/mksc checked Nov 2); OpenAlex abstract read from data/frame/mksc.jsonl. Design read from the README and the main-results code; no package code was run.
